title: The Contact Process
description: Sulfur dioxide to sulfur trioxide over vanadium, the gas cooled between beds so the equilibrium never falls back far. Unlocks the Vanadium Bed and the Contact Process Tower.

puzzle.goal: Over the vanadium, X/(1 − X) = √(K·p) at equilibrium, where p is the oxygen's pressure. Write the equilibrium conversion X.
puzzle.name: Square-root law
puzzle.form: sqrt ( K * p ) / ( 1 + sqrt ( K * p ) )
puzzle.expr: sqrt ( K * p ) / ( 1 + sqrt ( K * p ) )
puzzle.ask: Find X for K = @{K} atm⁻¹ (750 K) and p = @{p} atm.
puzzle.method: Solve X/(1 − X) = s for X: X = s/(1 + s).
